title: Chapter 6: The Nameless Threshold
_comment: Chapter 6 remodel (2026-09-10, v2): map tripled in each dimension (was 60x34). This arc's climax - two maze segments (not one, not three, not forked - yet another distinct combination), each with hostiles embedded directly in their corridors, connected by one populated chamber. This chapter's 'riddle' is reframed as a Trial (courage/kindness/humility) rather than the listen/remember/answer pattern the earlier chapters share, and the existing climactic group-ritual finale (all 4 companions + Lara) is unchanged. Layout: the approach (cols 2-28), the Warden's First Trial maze (30-95, full height), a chamber - hostage + hostiles (97-106), the Warden's Final Trial maze (108-165, full height), the threshold itself (167-178).
